texts.zh:
我们应该在一个[Owner.GetPreFTLUpper]社会的母星上方[GetBuildGrow]观测站。这些空间站可以完成多种不同的任务，而任务的种类则取决于我们想要如何影响这些发展中的文明。

观测站的建造方式与£mining_station£开采站和£science_ship£科研站相同，但只能造在[Owner.GetPreFTLUpper]文明的母星上方。只需要选择一艘£construction_ship£工程船，然后在其舰队界面中点击[GetBuildGrowCap]观测站。

接下来选择你想要研究的[Owner.GetPreFTLUpperPlural]文明的母星，工程船就会自动开始建造。
texts.en:
We should [GetBuildGrow] an Observation Post above the homeworld of a [Owner.GetPreFTLUpper] society. These space stations can perform a number of different Missions, although our willingness to interfere with developing cultures will determine which ones are available.

Observation Posts are built in the same way as £mining_station£ Mining or £science_ship£ Research Stations, but they can only be constructed over the homeworlds of [Owner.GetPreFTLUpper] Civilizations. Simply select a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship, then click on the [GetBuildGrowCap] Observation Post button in its fleet interface.

Now select the homeworld of the [Owner.GetPreFTLUpperPlural] you wish to study, and the Construction Ship will begin its mission.
